subject: Approval request: Freightway enterprise bundle (premium support + custom integration)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Freightway enterprise bundle — approval for premium support + bespoke connector concession

Hi Marcus / Laura,

Following the call with Freightway yesterday, they verbally committed to a 36-month enterprise agreement (spend profile looks like $1.2M ARR first year with growth option). Key asks that are non-standard:

- Include Premium Support (24x7, named TPM, 4-hour P1 response) at no additional seat-based uplift for the first 12 months.
- Build a bespoke SFTP-to-API connector to support legacy telemetry for their gate ops (one-off engineering effort, estimated 3 sprint weeks).
- 35% total discount on hosted API list for the first year given their procurement targets.

I scoped the integration effort with Solutions and estimate a one-time engineering concession ~ $48k (effort + testing). Attached: SOW draft, pricing summary, and a quick integration diagram. Freightway is asking for exec confirmation by EOD Friday to meet their procurement window.

Request: Would like approval to: (a) waive the premium support surcharge for months 0–12, (b) green-light the engineering concession as off-invoice professional services (not capitalized into list price) capped at $60k, and (c) approve a one-year 35% hosted discount with standard terms thereafter.

If you want, I can redline a concession section in the MSA that limits precedent (timeboxed & non-transferable).

Thanks — Ben

--
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0149

Attachments: FW_SOW_v1.pdf (SOW, draft), pricing_summary_FW-ENT-2027-041.xlsx (pricing), redwood_integration_diagram.png (diagram)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Freightway enterprise bundle — approval for premium support + bespoke connector concession

Thanks Ben — clear ask and good context. A few quick thoughts before I escalate to VP/SalesOps:

1) Timebox & precedent: we should make the premium support waiver explicit to Freightway only, for 12 months, non-transferable, and carve out renewal pricing to default to standard published rates unless a renewal deal is signed with the concession extended.
2) SOW approach: mark the connector as a fixed-fee professional services deliverable (FW-Connector SOW) with acceptance criteria tied to test fixtures — this prevents open-ended dev change orders.
3) Discount: 35% on hosted list for year one is aggressive but within range if we keep the support waiver timeboxed and we get a strong reference + PO. Recommend we require a committed ARR milestone payment schedule (30/30/40 or similar) to mitigate churn risk.

Ben — can you confirm Freightway is willing to sign a 36-month commitment with milestone invoicing? Also need procurement contact and expected PO date.

I will put a short note to Laura and Rishi to request formal approval for the off-invoice PS concession and the support waiver. If we need an exec sign-off beyond Laura, I'll loop in Aparna.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Deals Desk Lead, Sales Operations

Subject: Re: Freightway enterprise bundle — approval for premium support + bespoke connector concession

Marcus / Ben — reviewed. High level position from commercial:

- Support waiver for 12 months: APPROVE conditional on documenting a reserved SLA fallback (i.e., automatic reversion to published support pricing at month 13 unless customer executes renewal with concession).
- Off-invoice PS concession: APPROVE up to $60k cap as off-invoice credit; require customer to accept SOW and sign acceptance criteria before final credit applied.
- 35% hosted discount for year one: limited approval subject to (i) signed 36-month term, (ii) 50% non-refundable initial payment within 30 days of signature, (iii) explicit case study/reference clause.

Please add these conditions into the concession section of the MSA and SOW. Ben — include the initial payment and reference clause in your commercial term sheet and confirm with Freightway.

Laura

Subject: Re: Freightway enterprise bundle — approval for premium support + bespoke connector concession

Nina / Samir — quick update from our side after internal review: we can proceed with the commercial path discussed. See high-level conditions below (internal approvals attached as SOW/pricing):

1) Premium Support: waived for months 0–12, after which published support pricing applies unless Freightway signs a renewal that extends the concession.
2) PS concession: Redwood will deliver the bespoke SFTP-to-API connector under an FW-Connector SOW, capped at $60k off-invoice credit. Acceptance criteria will be included in the SOW.
3) Hosted discount: 35% year-one discount granted contingent on a 36-month term and a 50% non-refundable initial payment within 30 days of signature.

We will prepare a redlined MSA section and the FW-Connector SOW and share the DocuSign link once the PO is confirmed. Can you confirm you can route the initial payment and target signature by next Wednesday (Feb 17)?

Thanks — Ben

Following up on final finance sign-off. Conditions I need captured in the deal record and contract before I mark the concession approved:

- Payment schedule: 50% due on signature (non-refundable), 25% at 120 days, 25% at 240 days.
- Credit treatment: the $60k PS concession will be recorded as an off-invoice credit tied to the FW-Connector SOW, not as a reduction to ARR for internal quota calculations.
- Risk clause: include a churn clawback if Freightway terminates within 12 months after signature — a pro-rata repayment of the off-invoice credit on a 12-month linear basis.

Once Ben confirms the payment milestone language in the redline, I will update the finance approval record and route for final exec countersign.

-Rishi
